correctness.rationale: Modular-four folding creates an achievable path in states 0,1,2 no cost higher than arbitrary signed-gap path; switching every 1→2 unit-step branch to 1→0 saves 2 at the branch, with at most 2 lost before the next unit step, where trajectories merge. Hence greedy minimizes cost for any order. For reorderable goods, 2C≥a+2b+|D_end| plus parity gives the bound, and explicit zero-return blocks and terminal blocks achieve every parity case including empty and unit-free. Exact DP independently checked 32,767 fixed sequences and 289 counts, plus the sharp {1,3} boundary.

value.rationale: The new cumulative maximum-envy objective has algorithmic hardness even under identical valuations; distinguishing 1-vs-2 positive values provides a natural nontrivial infinite tractable frontier. Stronger than generic pseudopolynomial feasibility, an online myopic rule is provably optimal despite fixed-order full-knowledge competitors, while the reordering formula exactly reveals a parity defect. The {1,3} counterexample identifies genuine sensitivity to the valuation ratio and guards against trivial generalization.
